Own web/index.html (structure only: payments table, filters, sync control, notes, workflow controls, notifications feed, #brush-count, and the #viz3d canvas mount), web/styles.css (all styling), web/app.js (page behavior: payments table with status/currency filters, sorting on the instant-backed fields, pagination; sync trigger plus degraded-state display while the vendor is down before the first sync completes; per-payment notes; maker/checker workflow controls gated by the token's role; notifications feed; and the TABLE side of the linked brush — clicking a row toggles that record in the ONE shared brush set, member rows carry data-brushed='true', #brush-count always shows the set size, coordinated with viz.js per the linked-brush contract owned by the web-viz slice), and DECISIONS.md (the three decided corners with EXACTLY the headings ## D1, ## D2, ## D3 — D1 brush persistence across a streamed mutation of a brushed record, D2 rejected-draft terminal vs resubmittable, D3 empty-with-progress vs blocking loader before the first sync completes). Plain HTML/CSS/JS, no build step, no CDN, no external code, works offline; built as a product the finance team uses daily, not a debug view. Consumes /api/viz/records and SSE /api/stream per the contracts owned by the api slice — renders the server's day field as-is, keeps amounts in minor units with per-currency exponents (EUR 2, USD 2, JPY 0, KWD 3), never sums across currencies. First data rows render within 2 seconds of page load when local data is present.
